snippet.title: The Riverside Incident - Found Footage TERROR
snippet.description:
RIVERSIDE INCIDENT: In July 1991, a group of hikers found a garbage bag containing a video tape. They believed the footage to be a prank. Limited portions of the tape have been released to the public in hopes of identifying the persons involved.
